# Third-party notices — vendored MapLibre GL JS 6.19.0

The vendored `maplibre-gl.mjs` / `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs` are the unmodified npm distribution files (hashes in MANIFEST.json).
MapLibre (BSD-3-Clause, LICENSE.txt) bundles the following runtime dependencies; their notices apply to the redistributed bundle.
Full license texts of every package below are in `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt` (generated by `vendor_maplibre.py` from node_modules and covered by MANIFEST.json); the single-file `planner-offline.html` embeds LICENSE.txt and that file in `<script id="third-party-licenses" type="text/plain">`.
